Plain text output format strips markdown syntax

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"output_format\":\"Plain\"}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<h1>Title</h1><p>Some <strong>bold</strong> text.</p>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
